sort_by.description:
Sort by for Treets on hub.

- `title`: title of the current version of the Treet.
- `created_at`: when the Treet is created.
- `expires_at`: when the Treet expires.
- `total_redeems`: the amount of redeems made on the Treet.
- `total_shares`: the amount of shares made on the Treet.
- `redeems_left`: the amount of redeems left.

Note that when not sorting by created_at, desc(created_at) is used as tiebreaker.
Also note that null values will be sorted last when asc and first when desc.
sort_by.title: TreetHubSortBy

embed_hub.description: Embed the hub owner of the Treet.
embed_hub.title: Embed Hub

hub_id.description: Filter on the hub with access to the treet.
hub_id.title: Hub Id

owner_id.description: Filter on the hub who made the treet.
owner_id.title: Owner Id

partner_id.description: Filter on partner that has received or given Treet to given hub. hub_id must also be given.
partner_id.title: Partner Id

pack_id.description: Filter only Treet that are in the given pack.
pack_id.title: Pack Id

inverse_pack_filter.description: If true, only returns treets that are not in given pack. pack_id must also be given.
inverse_pack_filter.title: Inverse Pack Filter

category_id.description: ID of category to fetch treets with.
category_id.title: Category Id

is_expired.description: If `true` only expired treets are returned. If `false` only treets that are not expired are returned. If not set: expired and not expired treets are returned.
is_expired.title: Is Expired

state.description: Filter by Treet state. If not set, all states are returned.

items.title: TreetState
items.description:
The state of a Treet.

- `active`: The Treet is active.
- `inactive`: It cannot be redeemed but should be shown in main stats.
- `archived`: It cannot be redeemed and should not be shown in main stats.

If the owner wants to never see stats for the Treet again,
then they should delete it instead of archiving it.

state.title: State

access_state.description: Filter on how the Hub has access to the Treets. If not set, all states are returned.

anyOf.title: TreetAccessHubState
anyOf.description:
Describes how the Hub has access to the Treet.

The values are ordered by priority.

E.g. if the Hub has direct access and suddenly get owner access,
then it will be changed to owner access.
But if it has direct access and suddenly gets partner access,
then it will not change.

- `owner`: The Hub is the owner of the Treet.
- `direct`: An admin or similar has given the Hub direct access to the Treet.
- `partner`: A partner of the Hub has given the Hub access to the Treet.
- `world_wide`: The Treet was picked from a world wide pool.

Currently only owner and partner access is used.

access_state.title: Access State

medium_threshold_expires_at.description: Threshold for expires at in days to be medium.
medium_threshold_expires_at.title: Medium Threshold Expires At

critical_threshold_expires_at.description: Threshold for expires at in days to be critical.
critical_threshold_expires_at.title: Critical Threshold Expires At

medium_threshold_redeems_left.description: Threshold for redeems left as a percentage to be medium. Example: if 20, then for redeem limit of 10 and 2 redeems left (2/10=20%), it will be medium, but redeem limit of 5 and 2 redeems left (2/5=40%) is not.
medium_threshold_redeems_left.title: Medium Threshold Redeems Left

critical_threshold_redeems_left.description: Threshold for redeems left as a percentage to be critical. Example: if 20, then for redeem limit of 10 and 2 redeems left (2/10=20%), it will be critical, but redeem limit of 5 and 2 redeems left (2/5=40%) is not.
critical_threshold_redeems_left.title: Critical Threshold Redeems Left

hub_member_treet_role.description: Filter by role current user has to the . If not set, all roles are returned.

anyOf.title: HubMemberTreetRole
anyOf.description:
The access role of a Hub member in terms of Treet access.

This is simplified compared to the main Hub roles, as here we only
care about access to Treets.

- `write`: roles that can write to the hub
- `read`: roles that can only read from the hub

hub_member_treet_role.title: Hub Member Treet Role

redeem_limit_hit.description: If true, only returns treets with their redeem limit hit. If false, only returns treets that have not hit their redeem limit.If not given, both fully redeemed and not treets are returned.
redeem_limit_hit.title: Redeem Limit Hit

highlight_featured_treets.description: If true, places featured treets first and sets field `is_featured`. `pack_id` must be set and `inverse_pack_filter` must be false.
highlight_featured_treets.title: Highlight Featured Treets
